criterion: Is the layout clear and visually structured?
Are interactive elements (e.g., buttons, icons) clearly recognizable?
Is the amount of information per item appropriate and helpful?
Are interface elements used consistently (e.g., icons, labels, colors)?
Can users explicitly express preferences (e.g., ratings, likes, categories)?
Is there transparency about how input affects recommendations?
Do users have control and flexibility (e.g., skip, edit, undo inputs)?
Are recommendations clearly labeled as such?
Are different types of recommendations distinguishable (e.g., "Because you liked...")?
Are there explanations for why items are recommended?
Can users interact with recommendations (e.g., rate, hide, save)?
